paite: TOUPA phat un. Mithudikte omkhawmna ah leh kikhopna ah, ka lungtang tengteng in TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu ka hilh ding hi.
heading: TOUPA Phatna

paite: TOUPA thilhihte athupi a, atung a kipak peuhmahte zonkhiak ahi nak hi.
Anasep azahtakhuai in athupi a; adiktatna tangtawn a om ding ahi.
Ama'n athillamdang hihte atheigige a; TOUPA mihehpih theitak, zahngaihna a dim ahi.
Amah laute kiang ah nek ding apia a; athukhun tangtawn in atheigige ding.
Athilhihtheihdan amite kiang ah alangsak a, namte gouluah ding akiang ua pia in.
Akhut thilhihte thutak leh vaihawmna dik ahi a; athuzohna thute amuanhuai hi.
Huaite tangtawn tangtawn a ding in hihkip in a-om a, thutak leh diktat a hih ahi chiat hi.
Ama'n amite kiang ah tatna asawl a; athukhun tangtawn a ding in asep a; amin asiangthou in azahtakhuai hi.
TOUPA kihtak pilna bul ahi a; huchibang a hih mite'n theihsiamna hoih anei uhi; ama phatna tangtawn a om ding ahi.
